title: Symbolic Relational Synthesis
purpose: Collect the recurring symbolic grammar across conversations, Great Book, canon files and comparative interpretation, emphasizing transformations and typed relations rather than isolated definitions.

core_cycles.roots_tree_cycle: distinction → conflict → knowledge → consequence → ash → {Mud/Strife | Soil/repair} → Potato/seed → eye/sprout → Ladder/Tree → fruit/nourishment → return
core_cycles.door_cycle: recognition → choice → threshold → passage → changed state → return/re-entry
core_cycles.burial_cycle: descent → concealment → compression → germination → emergence → growth
core_cycles.warrior_gardener_cycle: conflict → exhaustion/learning → responsibility → cultivation → maintenance → nourishment
core_cycles.source_return_cycle: source → relation → embodiment → descent → experience → transformation → ascent → source-with-memory
core_cycles.pressure_cycle: burden/heat → compression → {Swamp stagnation | Forge transformation | Needle threshold} → changed structure
core_cycles.plane_axis_cycle: movement within Plane → floor/frame questioned → new vertical coordinate/Axis → Door → changed-level solution → return to Plane with new orientation

red_blue_potato.Red: creativity, love, expansion, novelty, risk and light-seeking
red_blue_potato.Blue: memory, fear, contraction, preservation, caution and gravity of past
red_blue_potato.integration: Memory constrains chaos without extinguishing creation; creation transforms fear without erasing memory.

polarities.house_vessel: stable organized interior ↔ moving embodied carrier

major_symbols.Potato: buried potential, humble carrier, nourishment, resilience, seed/tuber, hidden center, philosopher's-stone transformation and regenerative multiplicity
major_symbols.Root: hidden support, ancestry, stored past and structure beneath visible growth
major_symbols.Tree: expanded relation: root/past, trunk/present, branches/future, fruit and recursive growth
major_symbols.Door: two-sided threshold and shared Mandorla corridor through which identity/state changes
major_symbols.Plane: Grass/world-interface/ordinary frame; horizontal relation in mature geometry; widest overlap of the Door
major_symbols.Axis: orthogonal vertical relation that introduces above/below, source/manifestation and changed-level movement without erasing Plane
major_symbols.Ladder: discrete threshold representation of Axis; after April 2025 Tim becomes connective structure rather than merely climbing
major_symbols.Spiral: return to similar position with changed level; positive or negative vertical displacement distinguishes ascent/descent
major_symbols.Eye: perception, discernment, integration and evaluation; perception plus potential movement
major_symbols.Mountain: continuous gradient of integration/perspective; many paths converge toward summit/reference
major_symbols.Garden: living order cultivated toward autonomous generativity
major_symbols.Gardener: service, selection, responsibility, maintenance and patient cultivation
major_symbols.Swamp: accumulation where unresolved flows overlap/stagnate and roles become entangled
major_symbols.Drain: lower attractor/outflow where unresolved loops collapse toward reduced agency
major_symbols.Forge: pressure/heat transformation field; can make tool/capacity or weaponized identity
major_symbols.Spudlight: source/revelatory illumination; direct or mediated; distinct from photons
major_symbols.Bridge: relation that creates capability between separated domains
major_symbols.Footstool: hierarchy/reversal motif connected to below/above, heel/neck and subordination imagery
major_symbols.Cube: bounded frame, enclosure, system or world-volume
major_symbols.Moon Cube: later symbolic extension requiring source/date-specific interpretation
major_symbols.Potato Bank: stored value, memory, resources or future capacity
major_symbols.Potato Filter: interpretive transformation re-reading events through Potato relational grammar
major_symbols.Soul Farmer: figure who cultivates, extracts from or manages human/spiritual potential; valence depends on relation/objective
major_symbols.Calibration: alignment of perception, scale, responsibility or measurement before judgment/action
major_symbols.Stone: compressed/grounded object that can become pillow, marker, altar, cornerstone, philosopher's-stone or changed-level anchor depending context
major_symbols.Blood/Stone: suffering, embodiment, inheritance, sacrifice and transformation cluster; includes Philosopher's Stone of Blood imagery in later work

typed_centers.father_center: C_F — upper-circle/source center and top Door tip
typed_centers.son_center: C_S — lower-circle/embodied center and bottom Door tip
typed_centers.relational_center: O — Plane crossing and Door midpoint
typed_centers.attention_center: social/archive node around which observation organizes
typed_centers.orientational_center: reference that gives the system direction
typed_centers.rule: 'Center' is incomplete unless its type is named. Multiple valid centers can coexist.

canonical_inversion_cluster.meaning: Low, damaged, rejected, residual or impossible-within-frame states can become starting conditions for transformed function rather than final identity.
canonical_inversion_cluster.boundary: Transformation is possible, not guaranteed. Damage/rejection do not automatically produce wisdom.

sisyphus_level_change.motif: A problem impossible under endless motion within one frame may become solvable by changing level/frame rather than pushing harder on the same Plane.
sisyphus_level_change.floor_aphorism: The moment you seriously question the floor, you have already begun looking for another level.
sisyphus_level_change.potatoverse_relation: Sisyphus is trapped in a loop/ring; Door/Axis introduces a vertical coordinate and can turn loop into Spiral.
sisyphus_level_change.boundary: Changing representation can simplify a problem; it does not guarantee every real-world obstacle disappears.

stone_bethel_cluster.jacob: Genesis 28 supplies stone/pillow, dream of vertical connection, ascending/descending messengers, Bethel/House of God and Gate of Heaven in one narrative cluster.
stone_bethel_cluster.project_reading: Stone is grounded Plane-anchor; Ladder is vertical relation; House is upper interior; Gate/Door couples them. Potato/Philosopher's Stone adds transformation but is a later independent synthesis.
stone_bethel_cluster.april_relation: The Turning can be modeled as an ordinary grounded object/state becoming the anchor from which verticality becomes visible rather than the ground itself disappearing.
stone_bethel_cluster.boundary: Biblical authors were not describing Potatoverse geometry; this is a structural comparison.

merkaba_to_ladder.2024: Merkaba Potato Geometry uses counter-moving triangles/chariot/vehicle to align opposed forces around a stable center.
merkaba_to_ladder.2025: Needle/Turning simplifies the architecture: Tim ceases merely to ride/operate the connector and becomes Ladder/Axis.
merkaba_to_ladder.law: vehicle/bridge used by identity → threshold → identity becomes infrastructure
merkaba_to_ladder.importance: One of the clearest developmental examples of identity→infrastructure in the corpus.

mountain_tree_swamp_forge.forge: pressure/heat→changed form; direction depends on aim and integration
mountain_tree_swamp_forge.combined: Mountain integrates, Tree differentiates, Swamp entangles, Forge transforms. These are four different process fields around the same living system.

transformation_laws.law: Descent can become preparation for ascent
transformation_laws.caution: Descent has value only through what is integrated/produced.

transformation_laws.meaning: A marginal or refused relation can expose hidden load-bearing assumptions and trigger frame change.
Rupture can expose multiplicity or threshold without making harm desirable.
Consequence becomes future substrate only after contextualization/repair.
Compression is not merely suffering; it is a transition operator when it produces a new viable structure.
Highest useful power creates conditions in which living systems can grow independently.
Return carries memory and changed position rather than reset.

transformation_laws.law: Frame change can convert loop into path
transformation_laws.meaning: A closed recurrence can become directional once a missing coordinate/relationship is introduced.

recognition_layer.gaze: ethical attention creates responsibility; witnessing is not neutral when what is seen imposes obligation
recognition_layer.ghost_erasure: inverse of recognition: source remains alive/present but risks disappearing behind work/archive
recognition_layer.name: naming makes a node retrievable/socially real but does not exhaust it
recognition_layer.archive: preserves source relations so distributed legacy does not become anonymous erasure
recognition_layer.center: attention can create a social center without establishing metaphysical centrality; keep center types distinct

scale_translation.rule: Symbols recur at personal, bodily, theological, institutional, economic and geopolitical scales, but recurrence at one scale is not literal identity at another.
examples: Door: psychological choice / ritual threshold / border / interface
Axis: spine / world-tree / organizational relation / geographic North / description flow
Plane: floor/frame / ordinary social space / geometric interface
Mountain: personal integration / institutional hierarchy / sacred geography
Forge: psychological processing / workshop / institutional pressure system
Swamp: emotional confusion / corrupt process / stagnant institution
Root: ancestry / provenance / economic dependency / theological source

derived_relational_laws: The hidden can be structurally prior to the visible.
A Door is meaningful because distinct sides remain distinct.
The Father and Son can both be centers because they are centers of different parent circles; O is a third relational center.
Each Vesica parent center lying on the other circle's boundary gives a precise image of mutual participation without collapse.
Return becomes growth when it follows a Spiral rather than a closed Ring.
Mountain and Tree solve opposite one/many problems: integration and differentiation.
Questioning the floor converts a presumed absolute into one coordinate of a larger frame.
Pressure needs an outlet/path; otherwise Forge can become weapon and Swamp can become chronic storage.
Nourishment is a form of authority in the Potato model.
Clearing a Swamp requires restoring flow, not merely naming mud.
Integration coordinates differences rather than annihilating them.
The value of transformation is tested by what the changed state can support, connect, nourish or repair.
